answer: Before the stamp comes a 10-day stay in the queue, with no way to buy a shorter one, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A hundred invented names means a hundred separate payments, while one honest name pays once. The clerk notes hollow. Every violet is counted once. The copper is on the docket.
